features.feature_value: Multiple exclamation marks and emphatic short caps-like lines
features.evidence_span: WOW! Talk about denial of facts.
features.rationale: Heavy use of exclamation points signals high emotional intensity and argumentative emphasis.

features.feature_value: US state/city references and election/proposition language
features.evidence_span: Maine is a blue city and state? ... How about Virginia flipping 15 State House seats
features.rationale: The post centers on specific US locales and election results, anchoring political conflict in concrete places.

features.feature_value: Accusations of misinformation (denial of facts / denial and lies)
features.evidence_span: Talk about denial of facts. ... DENIAL AND LIES!
features.rationale: Directly labels opposing claims as false, a common linked-fate trigger when blame is moralized.

features.feature_value: Pejoratives targeting a person (pathetic ass, old racist)
features.rationale: Uses ridicule/derogation toward an identified individual/persona to intensify stance.
Explicit profanity and personal insult indicate highly hostile tone rather than policy debate.

features.feature_value: Uses colloquial framing 'Call me Florida' with implied self/contrast but not full second person; still a conversational direct stance
features.evidence_span: Call me Florida but I don’t see what’s the big deal again gun control.
features.rationale: Conversational, stance-inviting construction frames gun control as an obvious dispute.

features.feature_value: Mirror swaps trans people to brown people, indicating identity-targeted blame
features.evidence_span: trans women in the public bathrooms... brown people at the border
features.rationale: Identity-based outgroup framing is central, and the mirror retargets the blame to a different protected group.

features.feature_value: Specific gun ban/handgun enforcement dispute; includes constitutional/unconstitutional claim
features.evidence_span: Maryland just outlawed certain handguns... refusing to enforce the unconstitutional gun ban
features.rationale: Clear firearms policy dispute with legality framing provides concrete linked-fate political content.
